headline: Green on the stock exchange at the start of the week. High liquidity on the bond market
summary: The total value of transactions on the main market of the Bucharest Stock Exchange reached the equivalent of EUR 288.70 million at the start of the week. Bond market liquidity was also high.
why: The Bucharest Stock Exchange is Romania's main equity venue and its BET index tracks the largest local listed companies. Turnover indicates investor participation in the local market.
